label: Test rational exercise as formative rather than merely classified
summary: Continuation of PR-1971 and PR-1962. Note: docs/notes/will-versus-chance.md#can-the-same-intrinsic-actuality-understand-and-produce-blindly-2026-11-25. Inspected the existing agency overlay and actual theorem A (b5b84276): intellect, will bridge, rational-power bridge, owned exercise and one power yield rational power classification of actual giving. This excludes a separate non-rational exercised power conditional on those premises, not wholly blind actual governance on a thin Exercises reading. Read Aristotle Metaphysics Theta.2/5 and Aquinas ST I q.25 a.1 co./ad 3–4 and a.5 ad 1 in the linked primary translations for navigation; no registered attribution. The understood account is the distinctive formative rationale of productive art; actual exercising qua rational inclination gives direct conceptual warrant for an operative apprehended good at some scope, not determination of every effect. The actual application of this strong sense to giving is OPEN. Contrast a separate intrinsic blind constituent with a proposed one-actuality contemplative source knowing its own objective good-directed propensity; identity does not transfer relevance under intentional descriptions, and explanatory aspect distinction alone does not establish real constituents. Actual governance of the productive exercise and residual selection among permitted realizations have different explanatory scopes. A rival supplying only the latter given a genuinely directed giving is not a replacement for the former. Neither case is a strict-simple metaphysical model. Own-good love, recipient-directed good, full existential PSR, and same-source/holder bridges retain their independent obligations. No frozen dictionary or proof change, new formal consequence or attributed claim. P1 on prior PR-1971 head was corrected; fresh independent semantic review and applicable final CI remain pending.
blocker: Establish a same-source formative interpretation of actual existential giving as exercising its own rational inclination, not just the ownership/classification of the operative power; or construct a defended one-intrinsic-actuality contemplative propensity with actual supply and content under the same simplicity conditions. Do not use a hypothetical change of the necessary intrinsic state or classify a residual indeterminate outcome as a wholly blind exercise. Reassess recipient-specific willing separately.

current_assessment.assessment: A power identified as rational leaves open whether the giver’s apprehended good specified this giving. A good-responsive impersonal producer retains equal credit for the matched output.
